birthRepair.trigger: Seed 26018 released a Lux missile during the actor loop, then a later melee hit destroyed the Nexus before projectile advancement. The old empty birth history generated a frame with tick/trailDistance but missing x/y/facing.
birthRepair.repair: Capture the actual projectile position/direction at Lux/Gromp release; replace that frame during normal same-tick projectile advancement, retaining it when victory cancels the projectile. No damage or timing change and no decoder weakening.
birthRepair.failureCauseReporting: The QA runner now retains Error.cause name/message as a separate diagnostic field. Success reports retain null.
birthRepair.gameplayComparison: All recorded pre-repair minute/terminal samples and all four winners/ticks match fresh repaired runs. The failed seed-26018 terminal snapshot matches after changing only ruleset and Lux birth history.

limits: Four seeds do not certify balance, natural human play, the roadmap 100-seed gate or a universal match-duration improvement.
Current-position circle coverage does not predict future movement, guaranteed spell hits, later aggro or enemy cooldowns.
